releases.name: v1.1.2
releases.body:
- Added a couple more camera angles to the title screen variation
- Fixes a bug where the minimap would enable itself when you put your suit on regardless of whether you had it disabled in the settings (Thanks @Etherpod)
releases.bodyZh:
- タイトルスクリーンのバリエーションにいくつかカメラアングルを追加しました
- 最小マップが設定で無効にされていてもスーツを着用すると自動で有効になるバグを修正 (Thanks @Etherpod)

releases.name: v1.1.1
releases.body: - No longer gives you epileptic seizures when not in zone 1
releases.bodyZh: - ゾーン1以外では癫痫を引き起こさなくなりました

releases.name: v1.1.0
releases.body:
- Ship and probe markers no longer appear on advanced minimap when they aren't on the same planet as you.
- White holes now keeps its material on the advanced minimap
- No longer need to reference this DLL to use the API
- Fixed some exceptions that happen when objects are missing
- Added support for Root Access
releases.bodyZh:
- 船と探査機のマーカーが、あなたと同じ惑星にない場合、高度なミニマップに表示されなくなりました。
- ホワイトホールは今、高度なミニマップにその物質を保持します。
- APIを使用するためにこのDLLを参照する必要はなくなりました。
- オブジェクトが欠落している時に発生するいくつかの例外を修正しました。
- Root Accessのサポートを追加しました。

releases.name: v1.0.7
releases.body: - Fix brittle hollow fragments not updating on Advanced Minimap due to removing the proxy bodies on map objects last update
releases.bodyZh: - 脆い空洞のかけらが、地図オブジェクトの最終更新時にプロキシボディを削除したため、高度なミニマップで更新されないのを修正

releases.name: v1.0.6
releases.body:
- Fix nicer ringed planet from messing with the original when the setting is disabled
- Stop proxy errors when using with New Horizons (these weren't a big deal, just annoying lol)
releases.bodyZh:
- 設定を無効にした場合、オリジナルを壊さないようにリング付き惑星を修正
- ニューホライズンズと使用時にプロキシエラーを停止（これらは大きな問題ではなかったが、面倒だったよ lol）

releases.name: v1.0.5
releases.body:
- Added Andalûh and Basque translations for the "skip to" prompts
- Only inside Giant's Deep will show up on the advanced minimap now
- Tornados now only show up if they are active in hierarchy

releases.name: v1.0.4
releases.body:
- Adding translations to "skip to" prompts (#2)
  - Thanks @omega-fallon
- Make other Stranger HUD markers activate the Stranger skip prompt (#3)
- Added a setting to disable the Skip to Ship/Stranger prompts

releases.name: v1.0.3
releases.body: Fixed issue where would blink when try to roll with jetpack in zero-g.

releases.name: v1.0.2
releases.body:
- Added ability to blink with gamepad (left shoulder, when not holding anything or controlling ship)
- Added blink animation for skipping to ship to smooth it a bit
- Fixed ringed planet atmosphere when NH is installed
- Fixed some other issues with NH
- Fixed ship thruster flame also turning green
- Fixed softlock when sleep at ship computer

releases.name: v1.0.1
releases.body:
## Changelog
- Fixed issue with blinking
- Fixed base game maps being displayed on some New Horizons planets
- Fixed issues with Slate and skipping
- Fixed green jetpack not resetting on loop properly
- Made map Ash Twin Sand Column fade in and out

## Known Issues
- Blinking on the Quantum Moon can sometimes cause instant death and other issues
